explanation: The English Wikipedia article "Mudan incident" (revision 1363455951) says: "Because the Ryukyu Kingdom was a tributary state of Qing China as well as within the Japanese sphere of influence (to whom they also had a tributary relationship), the massacre was used as a pretext for Japan to invade southern Taiwan in 1874 to avenge "Japanese nationals" and subsequently annex the Ryukyu Kingdom in 1879." The edge reads that sentence as: 1874 Japanese expedition to Taiwan was a response to Mudan incident, and nothing more.
